search_approximation: During each global pass, velocity/gate/phase search is restricted to the selected nuisance candidate and its adjacent grid values. Baseline, each pass boundary and final use the full frozen nuisance grid.
limitations: Physical MIDI notes follow firmware-confirmed 8-foot triangle/divider phase one octave below MIDI; raw saw is twice that frequency. Observed lower component is not always the played MIDI note.
Note onsets are inferred from audio with roughly 2ms uncertainty; unknown manual gate-off, velocity and relative oscillator phase are explicitly profiled, not recovered as facts.
Original Pinoesque excerpt contained a second same-note attack near0.895s; v2 stops at0.840s and includes release.
Harpie first release is inferred from its sequence step and amplitude trajectory. String Hold and Pinoesque manual release times remain nuisance parameters.
String Hold is ring-modulated by muted square VCO1; Harpie is hard-synced to muted VCO1. Muted oscillator levels do not remove modulation sources.
Gloeckchen is reserved as new validation; no engine score was used to choose it. Its first four sounding pitches and0.5s step spacing match the stored sequence.
Gain, oscillator phase, analog drift and recording transfer remain unobserved. No pitch/time warping; small corpus does not identify every analog parameter.
